description: This file contains test helper functions for setting up and tearing down environment in Flutter widget tests, specifically initializing sqflite FFI for database access, pumping frames and settling the widget tree, unmounting widget trees, and cleaning up app dependencies like download engines and database.

methods.name: initSqfliteFfiForTests
methods.description: Initializes sqflite to use the FFI implementation for tests, ensuring database operations work without platform-specific implementations.

methods.name: pumpFrames
methods.description: Simulates a number of animation frames in widget tests to advance microtasks and layout.

methods.name: pumpAndSettleBounded
methods.description: Pumps frames until the widget tree is idle or until a timeout, with a fallback to ensure progress during tests.

methods.name: unmountWidgetTree
methods.description: Removes the current widget tree and performs a bounded settle to clean up the test environment.

methods.name: disposeAppDependencies
methods.description: Cleans up app dependencies such as download engines and closes the database, to prevent resource leaks during tests.
